data.narrative:
Shield AI, a Series G defense & security company, is valued at $12.7B post-money following $1.5B+ in total capital raised. The applicable peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies across the defense & security sector: 2 public names and 8 private firms including Anduril Industries ($61.0B, Series H), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), Saronic ($9.2B, Series D), and Flock Safety ($7.5B, Series G).

Two triangulation methods apply to this stage. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $12.7B last post-money and applying a standard Series G-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.25x, implies a valuation of $15.9B. Peer-median analysis across the same-sector, similar-valuation-tier cohort of 9 comparable firms yields a median valuation of $7.5B, though the peer range is wide ($3.0B–$61.0B), reflecting heterogeneity in stage, technology maturity, and contract runway.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $6.4B (low) to $18.3B (high), with a median of $11.7B. The current $12.7B valuation sits near the midpoint of this range. Key uncertainties include dispersion within the peer set, particularly the outsized $61.0B valuation of Anduril Industries at a more advanced stage, and the limited comparability of public-market defense contractors to Shield AI's funding trajectory and business model.
